description: This PHP class file defines the 'codeTrackerCommands' class, which manages code tracker operations such as create, edit, delete, and connection checks within the TestLink project. It handles GUI initialization, user permissions, and interactions with the 'tlCodeTracker' manager.

classes.name: codeTrackerCommands
classes.description: A class managing code tracker commands, including CRUD operations, GUI setup, and connection testing within the TestLink environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database handler, code tracker manager, and permission whitelist.

methods.name: getGuiOpWhiteList
methods.description: Returns the whitelist of GUI operations.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes GUI object with action, permissions, labels, and descriptions based on caller.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for creating a new code tracker entity.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new code tracker entity, updates GUI based on success or failure.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for editing an existing code tracker entity.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing code tracker entity, updates GUI accordingly.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a code tracker entity and updates GUI for deletion.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the connection status of a code tracker implementation.
